facts.rationale: Correct exact source behavior: distinguish declared domains and software requests from unverified guarantees, and preserve numerical/counter/reset exceptions.

facts.value: Under saved interrupt mask removes queued rumble, writes direct-status0 on ports0..3 through OffN, throws away raw queue, requests PADRecalibrate(0xF0000000), clears reset_switch and restores interrupts. Does not clear reset_switch_status or published status arrays; does not directly issue PADControlMotor. Hardware recalibration completion is not guaranteed by this call. PADRecalibrate merges pending bits, excludes waiting/checking channels, disables affected polling and conditionally marks recalibration unless GameChoice bit0x40 is set; it starts reset work only from the idle sentinel.
facts.rationale: Correct exact source behavior: distinguish declared domains and software requests from unverified guarantees, and preserve numerical/counter/reset exceptions.

facts.value: Master renewal processes one group only when queued. err0 converts input; err-3 clears the error while retaining old input; other errors clear input. HSD_PadReset clears only the request latch; HSD_PadInit clears both history and request via defaults.
facts.rationale: Correct exact source behavior: distinguish declared domains and software requests from unverified guarantees, and preserve numerical/counter/reset exceptions.
